server.name: little-bookshop
server.title: Little Bookshop
server.description: Browse fictional books and a shared demo cart. No checkout.

tools.name: open_bookshop
tools.title: Little Bookshop
tools.description: Browse twelve fictional books. Open /books, /products/<book-id>, /cart, or /settings. All callers share a process-local demo cart.

tools.name: mention_books
tools.title: Search books
tools.description: Find fictional books by title, author, genre, or catalog ID.

tools.name: read_cart
tools.title: Read demo cart
tools.description: Read the latest shared demo cart and settings. UI changes persist here until the server restarts.

tools.name: set_cart_item
tools.title: Set demo cart quantity
tools.description: Set a fictional book's quantity (0 removes it, maximum 9). Shared demo only; no purchase or payment.

tools.name: update_bookshop_settings
tools.title: Update bookshop appearance
tools.description: Change selected shared demo appearance preferences. Omitted preferences stay unchanged. Resets on restart.
